posts.subject: My Test-Admin Applicaiton
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dream Community =)
Hey, my name is Andrew and I have decided to take the recommendations from my fellow friends to apply to be admin for the Dream Knife Server.

Q0 – Do I meet the requirements?
Yes, I do believe that I meet the basic requirements in order to become a Dream admin. I am 16 years old and would say I'm super active on the Dream Knife server. I started knifing maybe a couple of months ago which I soon then got rather addicted to it. As for this, I have accumulated a total of around 6500 Stamm points and counting. Currently, I've been trying to be active on TS3 and the forum, but this is a thing that I definitely will work on in the next weeksI also can assure you that I own a headset as well as being able to use TeamSpeak3. English may not be my mother tongue (since I was born in China, I can speak fluent Cantonese and some Mandarin) but I can still speak English to a good standard to where people can hear me clearly and I can understand what people are saying. I would love to learn German as I think it is a interesting language but that would be a long-term improvement for me as I struggle a bit learning new languages (learning French in school was dreadful). In addition to this, I am mature, respectful and loyal, as well as being assertive so overall, I would say I meet the basic requirements to become a Dream admin.

Q1 – What is your name? Real and In game.
My real name is Andrew and my in game name is Doo Doo (please do not take this as a act of immaturity but mainly as a source of easy referencing).

Q2 – How old are you?
I am 16 years old but definitely sound more mature as I frequently get comments on how I sound older (also my voice is very smoothing as many have said).

Q3 – Why do you want to join our administrative team?
As I have seen, through many fellow knife member’s applications, the knife admins are rarely online during my time playing so I would much appreciate helping them out in keeping order in the knife server. Having hackers, cheats and trolls can devastate a person's experience, especially a newcomer, so I believe that with my activeness on the knife server, I can stop these people from ruining other people's days and overall, boosting the community's reputation.
Also, I would like to give back to the community as I have made many new friends, had a really good time (and I'm sure many more good times to come) and a extraordinary experience so far while playing on the knife server.

Q4 - How long have you been playing on our servers?
I am not sure on exactly how long I have been playing on the knife server but if a stamm point is awarded each minute, then I should have played at least 108 hours.

Q5 – What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
Well, to be honest, I don’t really have any fun hobbies so I usually just relax in the knife server, listen to music, eat, and revise a bit when needed. I used to do karate but I decided to leave it (as a brown belt) because it started getting too expensive. As for many other people, my favourite way to pass time is probably to [sleep] but I'm normally a active person so I don't take naps often.

Q6 – Do you think of yourself as mature?
I strongly believe that I'm mature since I have grown up around elder people - I'm the youngest child in the family. In addition to that, I'm usually in a good mood which I believe enhances the mood of other players in the server and creating a lovely, soothing, calm yet [funny] atmosphere.

Q7 – Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
I believe I have been trusted countless times to be a high rank in a community. I am very trustworthy and reliable for example, I used to play Trove (a Minecraft like game) and helped a YouTuber (called Scythe Plays) by guiding him through the game. I left the game for a few months and before I knew it, he had over 30,000 subscribers and I was trusted with the role of officer for the community - which was the highest rank possible other from Leader so I had the power to kick people from the community if they showed misconduct. Also, I remember being an admin/officer for a lot of clans/groups on different games but this was a long time ago. I'm also building up a knife clan for talented knifers!

Q8 – When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
From Monday to Thursdays, I play from 16:00 to 22:30 . On Fridays, I play from usually 21:00 to 23:30 . On Saturdays, I play from 10:00 to 16:00 then I have work until 21:00 so I play after 21:00 to 23:00 . I am most active on Sundays as I am usually online from 10:00 up until 22:30 but I take regular breaks. My timezone is GMT.
If that's a bit too confusing, I have constructed a little table to help you visualize my gaming hours.

Monday - Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday 16:00 - 22:30 21:00 - 23:30 10:00 - 16:00 21:00 - 23:30 All day - 22:30



Q9 – User 1 calls User 2 a “cunt” and proceeds to insult him further – what actions would you take?
Considering I know their backgrounds and they are just messing around as a joke, then I would allow it but excessive swearing will be warned. However, if it's a serious case, then I would timeout User 1 for a moment to speak to him. I would interrogate him as to why he is insulting a fellow community member and if the person says its User 2 whose at fault. Then I would speak to User 2. Judging from what they both said, I would try to sort things out between them or give User 1/2 a warning. If User 1 carries on insulting him after my warning, he would be muted. However, if he's persistent and carries on insulting him via chat, then I would ban him for a few days. A permanent ban will be issued if they continue to not abide to the rules.

Q10 – What are your strengths?
I would say my strengths are that I have excellent communication skills – I can speak fluent English and Chinese but I guess Chinese won't be needed. This doesn't only mean talking in different languages but certainly also the ability to get along with people. Proudly, I excel at my school subjects and remain as school prefect, conducting behaviour in my school and maintaining order. Also, I consider myself as a fast typer, averaging to about 81 words per minute and typing the alphabet in just about 3 seconds.

Q11 – What are your weaknesses?
My main weakness would be that I cannot speak German. However, I will try my best in order to learn some basic German words and phrases so that I can communicate with a broader range of the community. I guess, a rather personal weakness, is that I trust people too easily. I mean, I can establish bonds with people quite fast which is good but bad as well but when it gets to knowing them for a bit, I usually trust them with things I know I shouldn't trust them with. Thus, I have been scammed far more often than normal and I hope that I can adjust this dangerous behaviour of mine while still remaining fun and interesting to talk to.

Q12 – Conclusion/Closing Remark
In conclusion, I hope that you can enable me to become admin in order for me to give back to the community. There are just constant people who break the rules on the knife server every day and I hope that I can become admin to control that. As I have stated, I meet every requirement needed to become an admin and I promise that I will not abuse my powers but use them to serve justice :’D. I am very active and type super fast, and most importantly, I am reliable, assertive but fun at the same time. I know I am lacking the important ability to speak German but I hope you find it in your heart that you can trust me and I promise you that, I will negev let you down :').


Thank you for taking the time to read my application.
- Doo Doo
